method: Float32 fields start from the rd_get Q24 values, use the same grid and the effective parameters (Q15, with da and db folded with the 1/20 of the Laplacian in the Q15 modes), and run the existing Float32 Euler step. Each concentration is compared cell by cell. Mode 2 isolates storage precision at 100x114. FitzHugh-Nagumo rows start the lib/fhn-simulation.ts fields from x = 4 s - 2 of the rd_get values in modes 1 and 3, use du and dv folded the same way and k and rest rounded to Q13, and compare v (species 0) and u (species 1) in x units, counting cells that differ by more than 0.04, 1% of the range of x.
